zh-CN.title: 灵途 OpenAPI 开发助手
zh-CN.description: 查询灵途 OpenAPI 文档，生成和审查开发者接入代码。
zh-CN.prompt: 帮我查找商品图片生成接口，并生成 Python 服务端调用示例。
zh-CN.input: 开发目标、编程语言、框架或脱敏错误信息。
zh-CN.output: 接口说明、接入代码与问题排查建议。
zh-CN.requirement: 查询公开文档无需 API Key；开发者应用调用业务接口时使用自己的服务端密钥。
highlights: 查询官方接口与字段定义
生成或审查服务端接入代码
排查脱敏错误，不执行业务操作

en-US.title: LINGTU OpenAPI Developer Guide
en-US.description: Look up LINGTU OpenAPI documentation and generate or review integration code.
en-US.prompt: Find the product image generation endpoint and write a Python server-side example.
en-US.input: Integration goals, programming language, framework, or sanitized errors.
en-US.output: Endpoint guidance, integration code, and debugging suggestions.
en-US.requirement: Public documentation needs no API key. Developer applications use their own server-side credentials for business APIs.
highlights: Look up official endpoints and field definitions
Generate or review server-side integration code
Diagnose sanitized errors without running business operations
